firstPlayerRule: Tournament turns start with the player who placed highest in the previous tournament. In the first game round or a tie, the player who most recently opened a real booster pack starts.
internalEvidence: The ©2015 Level 99 Games English rules state both the previous-tournament and real booster-pack criteria in tournament step 4. The title and credits match inventory BGG 151347.
